paragraphs: Anthropic Claude is a family of AI models from the developer Anthropic. The Claude Platform Docs list Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5, alongside specialized models and legacy models. Anthropic describes Claude Fable 5 as built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, and says Claude Fable 5.1 builds on it. Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are the same model with different levels of safeguards, that Fable 5.1 is generally available, and that Mythos 5.1 is available only through trusted access programs. Anthropic says Claude Mythos 5 is offered only to approved customers in Project Glasswing.

Anthropic offers the models through the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are described by Anthropic as the world's most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Pricing is listed per million tokens, for example $10 input and $50 output for Claude Fable 5, and $4 input and $20 output for Claude Opus 5.5. Anthropic also publishes Claude's constitution, a description of Anthropic's intentions for Claude's values and behavior, written for mainline, general-access Claude models.

price_limits.summary: Across the 15 versions, input prices run from $1 to $15 per million tokens and output prices from $5 to $75. Claude Haiku 4.5 is the cheapest, at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens. Claude Sonnet 5.5 has the largest context window, 1,000,000 tokens.

family_reading.text: Anthropic Claude is an API only family, with 15 versions listed and no open weights, so you cannot self host any of them. All 15 support reasoning, and context windows run from 200000 to 1000000 tokens, with the newest versions reaching 1000000 and 128000 max output. Prices vary widely by tier, from $1 input and $5 output per million for Haiku 4.5 up to $10 and $50 for Fable 5.1, while Sonnet 5.5 sits at $2 and $10. Inputs accept file, image and text, outputs are text only. Named results include LiveBench scores of 80.8 for Fable 5 and 80.3 for Opus 5, and an LMArena first place for Fable 5. The family suits long document and image work with reasoning, but the top tiers are costly and closed.
